newSources.title: Routeburn Track — Harris Saddle
newSources.story: Look from the Harris Saddle camera across rocky alpine ground toward a partly visible lake and cloud-covered ridges. Open the provider for the latest still and capture clock. Cloud can hide most of the Routeburn landscape; a clear patch does not establish track access, weather along the full route or safe walking conditions.
